messages:
Sam H: Heads-up — we need to finalize the 'elastic surge' add-on eligibility and launch gating before Thurs.
Anya C: +1. Customers keep asking that reserved burst applies to Hosted + Dedicated. Need clear rules.
Lucas G: My take: add-on should default to committed customers only (min_commit_usd or min_tokens). Open to a fallback for SMBs.
Marie P: Blocking concern: if we gate too hard we lose adoption. Proposal: eligibility tiers + a soft-fallback for historical peaks.
Sam H: Launch gating we discussed: (1) <3 unresolved customer blocking asks, (2) perf impact p95 <2%, (3) pilot/legal terms in place.
ops-bot: @Sam H Canary scheduled: staging rollout on 2026-03-23T03:00Z — check monitoring hooks :rocket:
Anya C: Quick spec sketch (will add to pricing doc):
```
addon: elastic_surge
eligibility:
  committed_min_usd: 10000    # or committed_min_tokens: 1e6
  allow_fallback: true
  fallback:
    percent_of_historical_peak: 0.10
limits:
  window_tokens: 5000000
  max_rps_per_customer: 250
billing:
  pilot_cost_share: 0.5
```
Lucas G: Cost sanity check: if 10 pilot customers each use 50% of a 5M window, infra delta ~= $12k/mo. Need to decide absorption vs cost-share.
Marie P: Recommend pilot model: 2-3 customers, 90-day pilot, cost-share 50/50, usage caps and admin overrides.
Sam H: Action items: Anya update pricing doc + examples; Lucas run cost sim and stress test by EOD Wed; Marie draft pilot T&Cs.
Anya C: UX/API notes: console badge + tooltip, API flag "elastic_surge: true" and admin override. Need example request for devs.
Lucas G: API example:
```
POST /customers/:id/addons
{
  "addon": "elastic_surge",
  "quota_override": 2000000
}
```
Sam H: Also telemetry: capture token consumption, fallback triggers, peak-to-average ratio, and latency delta per model.
Tim D: I can provide historical peak data by cohort — pinged. Will post CSV in #data in ~20m.
Marie P: Legal ask: ensure we define termination rights if pilot causes sustained cost blowouts. I'll loop in legal.
Anya C: Implementation note: backend needs to compute eligibility at booking time and attach an "eligibility_reason" to the customer record.
Lucas G: Ops: add a circuit-breaker that disables add-on globally if we hit infra budget threshold. Also a per-customer notification when fallback kicks in.
Sam H: OK. If we get all three action items done and the canary looks healthy, run the 2-customer pilot week of 2026-04-06. Target general availability 2026-04-20.
Anya C: Ping @Tim D for peak numbers and @ops-bot to ensure alert thresholds are in place :pray:
Tim D: Uploaded cohort peaks to #data — sending link: https://internal.redwood/data/elastic-surge/peaks.csv
ops-bot: Alert rule created: surge_addon_global_budget > 10000 USD/day => postmortem channel auto-subscribe :warning:
Sam H: Great. We'll reconvene Thu 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. Short sync only. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
